words: Some people say text becomes unreadable: it disappears by itself, or lines sit on top of each other.

diagnosis.summary: There is no single engine bug. ClampText's invisible twin and the animation primitives (FadeInView, PopIn, Sheen, tickers) were checked against the React Native 0.86 sources and cannot leave text hidden or doubled. What members see comes from layout defects under three conditions: text drawn over an icon or picture (event cards without a photo, seen in today's Android screenshots); fixed-height or non-scrolling boxes that overflow on a small phone or with a larger system font, which is capped nowhere; and the light theme, where gold text sat at 2.2:1 on white and the membership card showed navy text on black. Today's pass already cured the light-theme gold, the membership card, the guest account screen and three popups in the tree (not shipped yet); the event cards, the font-size cap and the news strip heights are still open.

causes.cause: Event cards draw their text on top of the placeholder icon when the event has no photo ("lines sit on top of each other"). The calendar icon is centred in the whole card while the title, date line, fee and countdown stack up from the bottom and cross the middle.
causes.evidence: C:\Projects\vibes-club-app\app\src\components\AgendaBlock.tsx:77-79 and :129 (fallback is absolute, centred, 46 px icon), :92-100 (bottom block), :118-127 (card 200x216, overflow hidden). C:\Projects\vibes-club-app\app\src\app\agenda\index.tsx:89-91, :152 (same fallback, 52 px icon), :109-134 (bottom block). Arithmetic for the home card at default font: bottom block = 38 + 92 = 130 dp, so the title starts at y=84-94 while the icon occupies y=85-131. Seen directly in C:\Projects\vibes-club-app\docs\reviews\2026-11-15\android-shots\home3-ar-dark.png and agenda-ar-dark.png (title and date line written across the calendar icon). Sequence: open home or the agenda, an upcoming event has no photo, the title is unreadable over the icon. Same pattern, milder, in C:\Projects\vibes-club-app\app\src\components\MeetupsBlock.tsx:60-62, :97 (two-line title reaches the icon). Related: pills and titles laid over photos that carry their own words (GoldenOpportunity.tsx:86-99 over a project image, meetup YouTube thumbnails) as in home1-ar-dark.png and home2-en-dark.png.

Available height is about 678 dp on a 6.1 inch iPhone, 562 dp on an iPhone SE, 476 dp on a 640 dp Android: the overflow is split top and bottom, so the last buttons are drawn over the version footer line and under the tab bar. app/src/components/WorkshopAd.tsx (old :90-135): Modal > centred backdrop > card with a 190 px photo, headline, an unbounded AI-written body, facts and two buttons, no maxHeight and no ScrollView; about 600-700 dp at default size, so on a short phone or at 1.3x the «لاحقًا» button (the only exit on iOS) is off-screen; it opens once a day on every home open. app/src/components/MembershipGate.tsx (old :150-196, styles :264-266): same pattern. causes.cause: The system font size is never capped (no allowFontScaling or maxFontSizeMultiplier anywhere in app/src), while a few boxes have fixed heights or dp-based reserved heights. Text and lineHeight scale, the boxes do not, so text is clipped or cards become unequal.
causes.evidence: grep over app/src: zero matches for allowFontScaling / maxFontSizeMultiplier. (1) Home next-event card, C:\Projects\vibes-club-app\app\src\components\AgendaBlock.tsx:18-19, :118-127 (height 216, overflow hidden, space-between): content height = 66 + (114 + 20 x title lines) x scale. At 1.0 one-line title 200 dp (fits in 214), at 1.3 it is 240 dp (the day/hour/minute labels of the countdown are cut), at 1.3 with a two-line title 266 dp (digits half cut), at 1.6 it is 280-312 dp (countdown gone). (2) News strip, C:\Projects\vibes-club-app\app\src\components\NewsCarousel.tsx:158, :251-252, :262-263: only card 0 is in flow and gives the pager its height, the others are absolute under overflow hidden, and equal heights rely on minHeight 54 / 44 in dp. At scale above 1 a two-line title is 54 x scale but a one-line title stays 54, so when card 0 is shorter than a later card the later card's last snippet line is clipped (29 dp at 1.3x, 59 dp at 1.6x). (3) The (tabs) bar on Android: app/src/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:87 with a fixed 49 dp bar (node_modules/expo-router/build/react-navigation/bottom-tabs/views/BottomTabBar.js:47); labels scale on Android only (BottomTabItem.js:17 turns scaling off on iOS), so they are truncated and cut from about 1.5x. (4) GoldenOpportunity.tsx:118-128 (height 220, content pinned to the bottom): the pill row is cut from about 1.6x. Other screens are flex-based and grow correctly. iOS Dynamic Type steps are 1.12, 1.24, 1.35 then 1.79-3.57; Android 1.15, 1.3 and up to 2.0.

causes.cause: ClampText keeps a stale line count when the text width or the font size changes while the screen stays mounted: the paragraph stays cut at three lines with no «اقرأ المزيد» pill, so the rest cannot be read.
causes.evidence: C:\Projects\vibes-club-app\app\src\components\ClampText.tsx:29-38 and :46-50: the measurement is keyed by the text only and the twin is unmounted after the first count. Sequence: iPhone, a screen with a three-line-or-shorter paragraph is open, the member raises the text size in Settings and returns, the paragraph now needs five lines but total is still 3, so overflow is false while numberOfLines={3} still applies (:42). Android restarts the activity on a font-size change (fontScale is not in configChanges, AndroidManifest.xml:38), so there it needs split-screen or a fold.

notVerified: Nothing was run by me on an iPhone or an Android phone. The only visual evidence is the Android emulator screenshots another session made today of the working tree (dark theme, default text size, Arabic and English); there are no light-theme, large-text or iOS screenshots.

Whether the live events and meetups lack photos, as they do in the emulator screenshots. If every live event has a photo, the title-over-icon overlap does not show in production and only the fixed-height clipping remains for those cards.
How many complaining members use the light theme or a raised text size. Both causes are proven in code but their share of the complaints is an inference.
The Android clipping of padded pill Texts was not reproduced; it rests on the code pattern, the other reviewers' note and the project's own recorded experience.

That entrance animations can never stay at opacity 0 on a real phone. By code reading they cannot: React Native 0.86 syncs the value back and re-commits when a native animation ends, Android overrides stale commits by default, iOS ignores stale opacity and transform commits while the animation owns them, and recycled views are realigned. The project did once see native-driver transforms go stale on real phones (the news carousel, 2026-11-02), so one look at a slow phone is still worth it.
The exact pixel heights at 1.3x and 1.6x are arithmetic from the style values (paddings, lineHeights, borders), not measurements.
The (tabs) bar label clipping on Android at large text sizes is derived from the navigator's fixed 49 dp bar and its font-scaling default, not seen.
Today's fixes in the tree (scrolling guest account, popups, gold text tokens, membership card colours) are unshipped and unseen on any device.
diagnosis.data:
CLEARED SUSPECTS
- ClampText twin (app/src/components/ClampText.tsx:46-50, :73): absolute, opacity 0, pointerEvents none, removed after the first onTextLayout. It cannot become visible, cannot push the real text to zero height, and all 16 call sites are column contexts (home hero / advisor / savings, about, golden, meetups, membership x3, partners, service, workshops). onTextLayout is emitted from the shared C++ paragraph layout on both platforms (ReactCommon/react/renderer/components/text/ParagraphShadowNode.cpp:351-357). iOS view recycling does not leak its opacity (RCTViewComponentView diffs against the view's own last props).
- FadeInView / PopIn (motion.tsx:31-43, :110-125), 375 and 51 uses: one-shot, start in an effect, stop on cleanup, restart to 1 on any dependency change; React Native ignores reduce-motion and the Android animator scale for Animated, so entrances always run. No path leaves opacity at 0.
- Loops (usePulse, NeonPulse, Sheen, GoldSweep, GoldDust, Wiggle): decorative only; today's pass made them rest under reduce motion. GoldTicker is not used by any screen.

FONT METRICS (read from the bundled TTFs)
IBM Plex Sans Arabic, all weights: ascent 1.085 em, descent 0.415 em, natural line = 1.50 x font size; glyph box up to 1.64 em (Regular) and 1.73 em (Bold).

STYLES BELOW 1.4 x (19 in the whole app, all single-line digits, codes or badges)
1.18 agenda badgeDay 22/26 | 1.22 badgeDaySm 18/22 | 1.27 tab label 11/14 (tokens.ts:255, GlobalTabBar.tsx:174) | 1.27 advisor time 11/14 | 1.30 number of the day 46/60 | 1.33 badgeText 12/16 (news/[id], posts/[id], WorkshopAd), goldenText, GoldenCompanyCard code, SectorStrip count, partners promoCode 36/48, StorePurchaseCard price 24/32 | 1.36 card number 22/30 | 1.38 vipText, meetups number and cta 13/18, MembershipGate price 26/36.
Body styles: display 1.47, title 1.50, subtitle 1.56, body 1.63, caption 1.54. Tight lineHeight is not a cause.

corrections: The colleague's own numbers contradict the cap decision. It says a 1.3 cap 'keeps every current layout whole', but its own AgendaBlock formula, 66 + (114 + 20n)·s, gives 240 dp at s=1.3 with a one-line title, against a fixed 216 dp card (app/src/components/AgendaBlock.tsx:19, :118-127). The countdown labels are still cut at 1.3. The news strip is already 15 dp off at 1.15 (NewsCarousel.tsx:262-263, minHeight 54/44). So a cap alone does not cure the clipping: the fixed-height cards and the reserved heights must change too, whatever cap is chosen.

The proposed fix for the event card ('anchor the placeholder icon to the top') would move the overlap, not remove it. The top of the card is already taken by the date badge and the pills (AgendaBlock.tsx:83-90 topRow; agenda/index.tsx has the same layout). On a 216 dp card there is no free band for a 40 dp icon. The fallback should have no icon at all (keep the gold wash), or show it only where no text is drawn. The overlap itself is confirmed: home3-ar-dark.png shows the calendar icon through «ملتقى المستثمرين الشهري», and rev-android-run.md item 9 found it independently.

The colleague planned a codemod over about 150 files plus a lint rule just to cap text scaling. That is heavier than needed. app/package.json already runs patch-package on postinstall (app/patches/ holds two patches). A one-line JS patch to node_modules/react-native/Libraries/Text/Text.js (processedProps around :289, defaulting maxFontSizeMultiplier) and the same in TextInput gives one app-wide default. It is pure JS, so it ships in the OTA bundle to every runtime: the native prop has existed in all binaries for years. It also caps text the app does not own (navigation header titles), which the import codemod would miss.

The light-theme cause is right but narrower than its wording suggests. theme/theme.ts:25 defaults to 'dark' and never follows the system appearance, so only members who picked «فاتح» in «حسابي» are affected. That is very likely a minority of the complaints.

The colleague's 'cleared' auto-rotating strips are not a fault in their mechanics. ProjectsBankCarousel.tsx:66-75 and RotatingBanner.tsx:35-43 ignore the `finished` flag and always fade back in, so the opacity cannot stay at 0. The 'disappears by itself' reading is about pace (4.5, 5 and 6 s), not a bug. The ranking 'possible' is fair. One gap: RotatingBanner has no focus guard, so it keeps rotating on screens that are not visible. That is harmless but inconsistent.

The ClampText stale-count case was checked: ClampText.tsx:29-30 keys the measurement by text only, and the probe (:73) is absolute with left and right set to 0, so it measures at the right width. The scenario holds, but it needs a live text-size change on iOS. It belongs at the bottom of the list, not among the main causes.
missedCauses: Android, the riyal symbol drawn ON TOP of the last digit. This is literally 'characters sit on top of each other'. Seen in docs/reviews/2026-11-15/android-shots/service-ar-dark.png («30,00» with the symbol over the last zero), and also service-form-ar-dark.png («15,000» above «ادفع الآن») and event-ar-dark.png (struck «1,500»). Cause: app/src/components/SarText.tsx:21-41 splits «30,000 ريال» and puts an inline <Image> inside the <Text>. When the symbol is the last thing in an Arabic (RTL) paragraph that ends in Latin digits, Android positions the inline image at the wrong edge of the bidi run. Labels where words follow the symbol («15,000 ﷼ للأعضاء», «وفّر 15,000 ﷼ بعضويتك») render correctly. Example call sites: app/src/app/service/[key].tsx:175-177 and :314. SarText is unchanged since M199 (before 97705af), so every member on Android has it, and today's pass did not touch it. iOS (NSTextAttachment) was not verified.

Android, typed text disappears under the keyboard on every form and in the advisor chat. The binary is edge-to-edge (app/android/gradle.properties:47 edgeToEdgeEnabled=true; always on with SDK 57 / RN 0.86), so android:windowSoftInputMode=adjustResize (AndroidManifest.xml:38) no longer shrinks the window. Every KeyboardAvoidingView passes behavior=undefined on Android: app/src/components/Screen.tsx:43 (all forms: sign-up, sign-in, service request, profile), app/src/components/advisor/AdvisorChat.tsx:253, app/src/app/contact.tsx:122, ProfileCompletionGate.tsx:186. Seen on the emulator: advisor-keyboard-ar-dark.png and advisor-keyboard-en-dark.png (the whole composer is behind the keyboard and the typed text is invisible), signup-keyboard-ar-dark.png and form-keyboard-ar-dark.png (rev-android-run.md items 1-3). Today's pass only fixed the iOS offset (Screen.tsx keyboardVerticalOffset), so the cause is still open in the tree. A member who types and watches the text vanish will describe it as 'text disappears'.

Android, ellipsis and single-line truncation clipped to «..» in inbox rows and carousel snippets (rev-android-run.md item 29, inbox-ar-dark.png), the «مصدر رسمي» chip cut to «مصدر رس…» (newsitem-ar-dark.png), and the one-line mixed banner text cut inside «App S» (home-nonmember-4tabs-ar-light.png, RotatingBanner/ServiceTile). These add to the colleague's padded-pill list, which only names news/[id] and contact for the tree.

Possible, not proven: on Android, FlatList defaults removeClippedSubviews to true (node_modules/react-native/Libraries/Lists/FlatList.js:162-167), and every row of the projects list, the news list, decisions and the advisor chat is wrapped in a native-driver FadeInView (app/src/app/(tabs)/projects.tsx:191, app/src/app/news/index.tsx:145, app/src/app/news/decisions.tsx:27). Detached and reattached rows with native transforms are a known source of rows going blank after a fast scroll on Android. The emulator pass did not report it, so it is a lead to check, not a cause.

Minor overlaps on Android: in SectionHeader the last line of the description touches the cards below (rev-android-run.md item 25, home3-ar-dark.png), and content is cut about 63 px below the native header while scrolling because of a doubled top inset (item 24, Screen.tsx edges). Neither is 'unreadable', but members may report both as text 'sitting on' other things.

finalFixPlan.change: Event cards without a photo: remove the centred calendar icon from the fallback. Keep only the gold-wash background. challenge.ownerMessage: Members saw unreadable text for several reasons together, none of them a crash. On event cards without a photo the title is printed over the calendar icon. On Android the riyal symbol sits on the last digit of some prices, and the keyboard covers what the member types. Large phone text sizes overflow some fixed-size cards and popups, and in the light theme the pale gold text is too faint (today's pass already fixed most of the light theme but has not been published). One update over the air, with no new app build, fixes all of this: remove the icon from photo-less event cards, fix the price symbol and the keyboard on Android, cap the text size and let the cards grow, then publish it together with today's fixes after one check on the emulator and on your iPhone.
